description: Non-executing manual source acquisition manifest. Records URLs and expected artifacts for human download only. Does not fetch data.
warning: Do not implement silent automatic downloads against this file without an explicit separate design review. /latest/ Wikimedia URLs are moving targets.

artifacts.preferred_alternative: https://dumps.wikimedia.org/nywiki/YYYYMMDD/nywiki-YYYYMMDD-pages-articles.xml.bz2 (replace YYYYMMDD with the dump date actually used)
artifacts.notes: Prefer a dated dump directory over /latest/ for bit-reproducible re-acquisition.
VPL format (verse-per-line). Extract nya_vpl.txt from the zip after download.

sources.notes: Do not re-acquire as an independent training source. Redundant composite of Bible and Wikipedia.

future_researcher_notes: Both primary sources were fetched manually; this repository does not auto-download them.
Record dump YYYYMMDD and archive SHA-256 at acquisition time.
Keep original archives under a versioned offline store if legal/compliance requires bit-identity of the dump.
Re-run scripts/data/build_inventory.py after placing raw text; do not edit files under data/raw/ in place.
